observations.title: Inspect a world's recorded play time
observations.player_action: Open the world selection list and read the top-right value on an entry.
observations.outcome: The client reads that world's existing Play Time statistic, including worlds created before installing the mod.
conditions: This is a local-world statistic, not an authoritative multiplayer server session ledger.
Any newly authored JEM time label must follow the project's Minecraft-day presentation rule.
External documentation is not installed-runtime proof; inspect the installed artifact/configuration before relying on defaults or exact compatibility.
observations.review_note: Presentation/settings alone do not provide an inventory completion signal. Any quest would require a documented native action or explicit manual confirmation.
